title: Email design
description: How every email to customers looks: replies, auto-replies and the satisfaction survey. Each brand has its own design.
readOnly: Only admins can change the email design.
resetLayoutConfirm: The layout goes back to plain, with no logo or footer, quoting the previous message.
resetCsatConfirm: The satisfaction email goes back to the built-in wording.

layout.modeHint: Simple covers most teams. Custom HTML gives you the whole email body.
layout.plainHint: Reads like an email from a person. Best for replies.
layout.brandedHint: A card with your logo and an accent line.
layout.logoHint: The brand's logo at the top of every email.
layout.noLogo: This brand has no logo yet.
layout.accentHint: Links, the branded accent line and the survey buttons.
layout.footerHint: Small print under each email, like your address or a link to the help center. Takes variables.
layout.footerPlaceholder: Acme Inc, 1 Market Street, San Francisco
layout.customHint: The whole email body. opendesk puts the message where you write {{content}}, the signature at {{signature}} and earlier messages at {{history}}.
layout.historyHint: Quoted under each reply so customers keep the context. Notes are never included.
layout.historyHeaderHint: Above each quoted message. Use {{author}} and {{date}}.

csat.off: Satisfaction surveys are off, so this email is not sent yet.
csat.subject: Subject
csat.subjectHint: The ticket number is added when it's missing, so replies thread.
csat.bodyHint: Must include {{survey}}, where the five rating buttons go.

variables.title: Variables
variables.description: Click one to copy its tag. Every template takes every variable; a value that doesn't apply is empty.
variables.logicHint: Show parts only when they apply, pick by value, repeat for each item of a list. Click an example to copy it.
variables.helpersHint: Filters change a value: add them after a |, one after another.

loadError.title: Email design didn't load
loadError.description: Something went wrong while loading this brand's emails. Try again in a moment.
